angle_tolerance_deg.rationale: screening window wider than any fit's angular sigma.

equal_radius_tolerance.rationale: screening window for radii that might be one parameter.

frame_margin.rationale: 10% of the winning score separates two datum candidates.

eigengap_min.rationale: half a percent of the spectrum pins one motion.

pitch_epsilon.rationale: two percent of extent per radian.

translation_epsilon.rationale: a twentieth of the unit six-vector.

offset_tolerance.rationale: screening window in mm for axis offsets at this part size.

sigma_multiple.rationale: three sigma: beyond it is not explained by fit noise.

event_merge_sigmas.rationale: three combined sigmas: two stations closer than three times their own joint measurement uncertainty are one station, and a slab thinner than what these fits can resolve is not evidence of a slab. The same sigma-multiple reading the licensing arithmetic already uses, applied to offsets instead of angles.

loop_attribution_min_fraction.rationale: how much of a loop may lie on triangles that cast no vote before its walls stop being evidence. The same five per cent as the consensus slack: a slab is sectioned at its midpoint precisely to be far from its own caps, so a loop grazing one there is a station problem.

loop_material_consensus_fraction.rationale: a loop's walls vote by length for which side of it the material is on, and on a designed export they should be unanimous. Five per cent is the room a blend crossing or a sliver at a corner needs; beyond that the winding is saying the section crossed a junction, which is a finding rather than a tolerance to widen.

section_tolerance_mm.rationale: a hundredth of a millimetre is below the smallest feature any of these parts carries and above the float32 quantization their vertices are stored at; the same number the rebuild spec sections with, so the planner and the emitter cut the same loops.

slab_constancy_tolerance_mm.rationale: five hundredths of a millimetre, the same window this corpus declares for binding a built face back to its fitted region. Two sections of one slab are the same wall measured twice; agreeing to less than this is agreement, and disagreeing by more is a taper or a step the slab premise does not cover.

slab_section_fractions.rationale: the quarter and three-quarter stations, the design's own doctrine default. Far enough from the midpoint that a taper or a mid-slab step shows up as disagreement, far enough from the bounding events that neither section grazes a cap and measures coplanar triangles instead of walls.

tangent_tolerance.rationale: screening window for tangency on a part of this size.
